comment: The phases are described using indicative timeframes and are allowed to overlap and iterate. Phase 2 does contain a useful outcome statement—a functioning, standards-conformant foundation used by real programmes—but this is not expressed as a measurable closure test, and comparable entry and exit conditions are not provided consistently for the other phases.

public.text: The phases are described using indicative timeframes and are allowed to overlap and iterate. Phase 2 does contain a useful outcome statement—a functioning, standards-conformant foundation used by real programmes—but this is not expressed as a measurable closure test, and comparable entry and exit conditions are not provided consistently for the other phases.
public.suggestedRevision: Convert the intended result of each phase into explicit entry conditions and closure criteria, while retaining timeframes as illustrations only. For example, formalise the Phase 2 outcome as defined components in production, conformance tested against published profiles, and used by the selected programme systems, with evidence recorded for each condition.
